terms.gloss: one who weighs things up, a valuer: an analyst
evidence: Cic. Par. 6.3: callidī rērum aestimātōrēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically one who sets a value on things, frūmentī (Cic. Pis. 35), and figuratively a judge of their worth, jūstus rērum aestimātor (Cic. Or. 41) (Lewis & Short). Its use for an analyst is modern, and ours: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for one, and Morgan–Owens gives aestimātor for an appraiser.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. appraiser.
